examples.text: yo c'āyaṃ bhikkhu saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpanno tassa'pi kāyasaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, vacīsaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, cittasaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, āyu na parikkhīṇo, usmā avūpasantā, indriyāni vippasannāni.
avūpasantacittassa anuppannañ'c'eva uddhaccakukkuccaṃ uppajjati uppannañ'ca uddhaccakukkuccaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattatī'ti

10757.meaning1: with an agitated mind; with an unsettled heart

examples.text: ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā uddhatā avūpasantacittā araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, uddhata-avūpasantacitta-sandosahetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.

10758.commentary: (SNa) cetaso avūpasamo'ti yathā nāma vīt'acciko'pi aṅgāro n'eva tāva sannisīdati patāpaṃ karoti'y'eva, yathā ca pattapacanaṭṭhāne n'eva tāva sannisīdati patāpaṃ karoti'y'eva, evaṃ cittassa avūpasantākāro, atthato pan'etaṃ uddhaccakukkuccam'eva hoti.

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammam'pi samanupassāmi yena anuppannaṃ vā uddhaccakukkuccaṃ uppajjati uppannaṃ vā uddhaccakukkuccaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, cetaso avūpasamo
ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā uddhaccakukkuccassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā uddhaccakukkuccassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? atthi, bhikkhave, cetaso avūpasamo.

10759.meaning1: no deformity; no imperfection; no defect

10760.meaning1: fact of having no deformity; non-defectiveness
10760.construction:
na > a + vi + √kal + ya + tā
avekalla + tā

10761.meaning1: sees; regards; views as; considers as

examples.text: evaṃ khandhe avekkheyya, bhikkhu āraddhavīriyo, divā vā yadi vā rattiṃ, sampajāno paṭissato.
pamādaṃ appamādena, yadā nudati paṇḍito, paññāpāsādam'āruyha, asoko sokiniṃ pajaṃ, pabbataṭṭho'va bhūmaṭṭhe, dhīro bāle avekkhati.
yāya mātu bhato poso, imaṃ lokaṃ avekkhati, tam'pi pāṇadadiṃ santiṃ, hanti kuddho puthujjano.
yathā pubbuḷakaṃ passe, yathā passe marīcikaṃ, evaṃ lokaṃ avekkhantaṃ, maccurājā na passati.
evaṃ abhikkantadassāviṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, kathaṃ lokaṃ avekkhantaṃ, maccurājā na passati.

10765.grammar: imp, reflx 2nd sg of avekkhati, trans (+acc)
10765.meaning1: you yourself must see; you yourself should regard
10765.meaningLit: you yourself must look down on!
10765.commentary: (NIDD2) suññato lokaṃ avekkhassū'ti suññato lokaṃ avekkhassu paccavekkhassu dakkhassu tulehi tīrehi vibhāvehi vibhūtaṃ karohī'ti, suññato lokaṃ avekkhassu. (SNPa) suññato lokaṃ avekkhassū'ti avasiya-pavatta-sallakkhaṇa-vasena vā tucchasaṅkhāra-samanupassanā-vasena vā'ti dvīhi kāraṇehi suññato lokaṃ passa.

examples.text: suññato lokaṃ avekkhassu, mogharāja sadā sato, att'ānudiṭṭhiṃ ūhacca, evaṃ maccutaro siyā, evaṃ lokaṃ avekkhantaṃ, maccurājā na passatī'ti.
examples.source:
SNP70 mogharāja māṇava pucchā
pārāyana vaggo 15

examples.text: sele yathā pabbatamuddhaniṭṭhito, yathā'pi passe janataṃ samantato, tath'ūpamaṃ dhammamayaṃ sumedha, pāsādam'āruyha samantacakkhu, sok'āvatiṇṇaṃ janatam'apetasoko, avekkhassu jātijarābhibhūtaṃ.

10766.commentary: (THIa) dhamm'ādāsaṃ avekkhiṃ'han'ti dhammamayaṃ ādāsaṃ addakkhiṃ apassiṃ ahaṃ.

examples.text: bhāvito me maggo, ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko amatagāmī, nibbānaṃ sacchikataṃ, dhamm'ādāsaṃ avekkhiṃ'haṃ.
tañ'ca sabbaṃ abhiññāya, avekkhitvāna cakkhumā, tato āmantayī satthā, sāvake sāsane rate.

10771.meaning1: perfectly; absolutely; (comm) having gone deeply with wisdom
10771.commentary: (SNPa) yo ariyasaccāni avecca passatī'ti yo cattāri ariyasaccāni paññāya ajjhogāhetvā passati. tattha ariyasaccāni visuddhimagge vuttanayen'eva veditabbāni.

examples.text: dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opaneyyiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī'ti
yath'indakhīlo pathavissito siyā, catubbhi vātehi asampakampiyo, tath'ūpamaṃ sappurisaṃ vadāmi, yo ariyasaccāni avecca passati, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.
paññāpaṭilābhagatena kammunā, manussabhūto sukhumacchavī ahu, byākaṃsu uppādanimittakovidā, sukhumāni atthāni avecca dakkhiti.

10773.meaning2: having a trust founded in knowledge

10774.meaning2: trust founded in knowledge, intelligent faith

10775.meaning1: with unwavering confidence; having absolute faith
10775.commentary: (ANa) aveccappasannānan'ti avigacchanasabhāvena acalena pasādena samannāgatānaṃ sūrambaṭṭho aggo'ti dasseti.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ aveccappasannānaṃ yadidaṃ kātiyānī.

10777.meaning1: faith founded in understanding; experiential confidence; epithet of stream entry
10777.notes: A syntactical compound according to Collins p.136.

examples.text: dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opaneyyiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī'ti

10778.synonym: aññāti, avabujjhati, jānāti, paccabyati, pajānāti, bujjhati, munāti, vijānāti, vedeti, sampajānāti

examples.text: ijjhatī'ti samijjhati mahapphalo hoti. yo'vedī'ti yo avedi aññāsi, viditaṃ pākaṭam'akāsi yo'vetī'ti'pi pāṭho, yo aveti jānātī'ti attho. passatī'ti dibbacakkhunā passati.

10779.meaning1: who does not have perfect knowledge; who does not have complete understanding

examples.text: taṃ kho pan'etaṃ, bhikkhave, udako rāmaputto avedagū'y'eva samāno vedagū'smī'ti bhāsati, asabbajī'y'eva samāno sabbajī'smī'ti bhāsati, apalikhataṃ'y'eva gaṇḍamūlaṃ palikhataṃ me gaṇḍamūlan'ti bhāsati.

10780.construction:
na > a + √vid > ved + *anā + a
avedanā + a

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, āvuso yamaka, ayaṃ so arūpī… avedano… asaññī… asaṅkhāro… aviññāṇo tathāgato'ti samanupassasī'ti? no h'etaṃ, āvuso.
no h'idaṃ, āvuso. taṃ kiṃ maññath'āvuso nigaṇṭhā, yam'idaṃ kammaṃ savedanīyaṃ taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā avedanīyaṃ hotū'ti labbham'etan'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.
puna evam'āhaṃsu taṃ khaṇaṃ taṃ muhuttaṃ ubhayam'eva avedayitaṃ sopādisesaṃ yañ'ca anupādisesaṃ yañ'ca taṃ khaṇaṃ taṃ muhuttaṃ anupādisesaṃ yañ'ca sopādisesaṃ ca avedayitaṃ.
thero'pi pucch'ānurūpen'eva byākāsi. tattha yasmā vedayitasukhato avedayitasukhaṃ santataraṃ paṇītataraṃ hoti, tasmā aññaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ uttaritaraṃ vā paṇītataraṃ vā na samanupassāmā'ti āha.

10783.commentary: (SNa) tesañ'ca ye saṃvaraṇaṃ avedisun'ti ye tesaṃ āyatanānaṃ saṃvaraṃ vindiṃsu paṭilabhiṃsu

examples.text: saḷ'eva phass'āyatanāni bhikkhavo, asaṃvuto yattha dukkhaṃ nigacchati, tesañ'ca ye saṃvaraṇaṃ avedisuṃ, saddhādutiyā viharant'ānavassutā.
yadā have pātubhavanti dhammā, ātāpino jhāyato brāhmaṇassa, ath'assa kaṅkhā vapayanti sabbā, yato khayaṃ paccayānaṃ avedī'ti.

examples.text: saḷ'eva phass'āyatanāni bhikkhavo, asaṃvuto yattha dukkhaṃ nigacchati, tesañ'ca ye saṃvaraṇaṃ avedisuṃ, saddhādutiyā viharant'ānavassutā.

yato kho, kassapa, bhikkhu averaṃ abyāpajjaṃ mettacittaṃ bhāveti, āsavānañ'ca khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.

examples.text: susukhaṃ vata jīvāma, verinesu averino, verinesu manussesu, viharāma averino.
na tena paṇḍito hoti, yāvatā bahu bhāsati, khemī averī abhayo, paṇḍito'ti pavuccati.

10793.commentary: (VINa) avehāsakuṭiyā'ti bhūmiyaṃ katapaṇṇasāl'ādīsu anāpatti. na hi sakkā tattha parassa pīḷā kātuṃ.

10794.commentary: (SNPa) pubbe vuttā tividhā'pi saccā avokkamma moneyyappattiyā munī'ti saṅkhyaṃ gato nibbānatthale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo, sa ve evarūpo sabbāni āyatanāni nissajjitvā santo'ti vuccatī'ti.

examples.text: saccā avokkamma muni, thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo, sabbaṃ so paṭinissajja, sa ve santo'ti vuccati.
mā-avoca pharusaṃ kañci, vuttā paṭivadeyyu taṃ, dukkhā hi sārambhakathā, paṭidaṇḍā phuseyyu taṃ.
evaṃ vutte, āyasmā moḷiyaphagguno bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ko nu kho, bhante, viññāṇ'āhāraṃ āhāretī'ti? no kallo pañho'ti bhagavā avoca, āhāretī'ti ahaṃ na vadāmi.
idh'āhaṃ, bhante, yen'aññataro bhikkhu ten'upasaṅkamiṃ, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavocaṃ, kittāvatā nu kho, āvuso, bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotī'ti?
tumhe hiyyo amhākaṃ gehe kiñci aladdhā'y'eva labhimhā'ti avocuttha
avocumha bhoto vacanena taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ, bodhi kho rājakumāro bhoto gotamassa pāde sirasā vandati, app'ābādhaṃ app'ātaṅkaṃ lah'uṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchati.
thero āha, mayaṃ, brāhmaṇa, tumhākaṃ gehe satta vassāni, aticchathā'ti vacanamattam'pi alabhitvā hiyyo, aticchathā'ti vacanamattaṃ labhimha, ath'etaṃ paṭisanthāraṃ upādāya evam'avocumhā'ti
sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekam'antaṃ nisinne kho te bhikkhū aññatitthiyā paribbājakā etadavocuṃ
vaca'icc'etassa dhātussa akāro ottam'āpajjate ajjatanimhi vibhattimhi. avoca. avocuṃ. ajjatanimhī'ti kim'atthaṃ? avaca, avacū.
